title: Lesson: Cold wave → Landau damping
description: Compare an undamped cold plasma oscillation with a warm Landau case. Watch |E_k| stay flat when v_th = 0, then decay when a thermal tail can resonate.

steps.prompt: Run this cold control first. Expect |E_k| to oscillate without a steady envelope decay.
Now run the warm Landau case. Compare |E_k| decay and the theory overlay / measured γ in the summary.

title: Lesson: Two-stream → vortices
description: Follow the classic two-stream pathway from linear growth to nonlinear trapping vortices in phase space.

steps.prompt: Start with the quick two-stream. Watch field energy rise after a quiet period.
Run the vortex showcase. Scrub phase space near saturation to see trapping islands.
Optional 3D view: rotate the counter-streaming beams as they mix.

title: Lesson: Plasma oscillation basics
description: See undamped electron plasma oscillations in 1D and 3D with smooth playback.

steps.prompt: 1D smooth oscillation — watch E(x) and energy breathe at ω ≈ ω_p.
3D breathing cloud — enable auto-rotate and loop the animation.

title: Lesson: Cyclotron motion in B
description: Apply a uniform B_z and watch electrons rotate at ω_c = |q/m| B with the Boris pusher.

steps.prompt: Run the cyclotron demo. Expect v_y to oscillate with period ≈ 2π while total energy stays flat.

title: Lesson: Magnetic field showcase
description: From pure cyclotron motion to 3D helices, oblique fields, and magnetized instabilities.

steps.prompt: Start with clean 1D3V cyclotron motion — perpendicular velocity rotates at ω_c = 1.
3D Larmor helix: enable auto-rotate and play. Each particle wraps a helical path (v_x + gyration).
1024 warm gyrators — watch the whole cloud spin like a storm.
Tilted B breaks the x–y plane symmetry; rotate the view to see the inclined axis.
B along x: gyration happens in the y–z plane instead.
Counter-streaming beams plus B_z — two colors mix in spiraling 3D structures.
Plasma wave breathing and cyclotron gyration at the same time.
Self-consistent E×B: slow drift in y on top of fast cyclotron wobble.
